perturbation of host T-cell mediated immune response
symbiont-mediated modulation of host cell-mediated immune response

broad: modulation by organism of T-cell mediated immune response of other organism involved in symbiotic interaction

definition: A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts the T-cell mediated immune response of the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host T-cell mediated immune response
